parts.text:
**Defining Style Variables**

I'm starting to build the foundational CSS. First on the list is setting up theme variables, especially for the background color. I've chosen a soft, inviting tone, `--bg-body: #f4f6fb`, perfect for a healthcare application. I'm focusing on responsiveness and modern design as core principles.


**Refining Background Color Palette**

I've established several new background color variables. I have `--bg-surface` for white cards, a gradient for `--bg-hero`, and specific colors for services and testimonials. Dark mode backgrounds, `--bg-dark` and `--bg-dark-footer`, are also defined. I'm actively integrating these variables into the body and section backgrounds.

**Resolving Layout Overlap Issues**

Now, I'm tackling navbar and hero section layout issues. I'm focusing on clearing navbar heights, flex alignments, and fixing the brand overlapping the toggle. I'm ensuring the hamburger menu is visible and styled to prevent overlaps. Then, I'm working on responsive heading sizes, preventing text overflow, and ensuring the hero image adapts well.


**Implementing Sectional Styles**

I'm now implementing styling for each section. The hero image is set to cover its container, and I've ensured button alignment with proper padding and hover states. I've styled the 'About' section, setting the image to full width and height with a defined border radius and shadow. I've employed flex layouts for checklist items. Services section cards are equal height. I'm aligning card titles and creating a top-border accent. Testimonial cards are centered, with adjusted typography. Finally, the contact and footer sections are styled for high-contrast and a clean appearance.

parts.text:
Updated the webapp styling in `index.html` and `css/style.css`:
- **Background Color**: Implemented modern background layers (`#f4f6fb` body, clean white `#ffffff` cards and about section, soft `#eef2fb` hero gradient, and `#edf1f8` services section).
- **Layout & Alignment**: Fixed mobile navbar toggler visibility (`data-bs-theme="dark"`), resolved card alignment with equal-height flex columns and unified title baselines, aligned feature checklist items with circular badges, and prevented text overflow and image collision across responsive breakpoints.
- **Font Family**: Replaced existing fonts with Google Fonts `Outfit` (headings/brand) and `Plus Jakarta Sans` (body text).
